title: Humor varieties

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Humor varieties are defined as the various mood states associated with differing qualities in being amusing, comical, or funny.

This page lists and describes the various humor varieties to explore when undergoing an increased sense of humor, which can occur under the influence of cannabinoid compounds. 

Black comedy

Blue comedy

Parody

Satire

See also

*Tripsitting index
*Subjective effect index
*Cannabinoids
